check_C00689.py. With the frozen repo MoDL and repo functions (attack_generation = unsupervised PGD, 10 iterations, alpha = eps/5; noise_jiterring; CG_EEH; ABA_detect), for N synthetic cases (N >= 8, fixed in script header) compute, under torch.no_grad and without any weight update, y_Omega = CG_EEH(FFT(z) * Omega) (as in Mitigation.py), zeta1 = ||y_Omega - E_Omega x_Omega||/||y_Omega|| (ABA_detect stage 0 k-space at Omega) and zeta2 = ||y_Omega - E_Omega x_Delta1||/||y_Omega|| (stage 1 k-space at Omega after re-undersampling with Delta_1 plus noise), for (a) clean inputs, (b) PGD-attacked inputs eps=0.01, (c) PGD-attacked inputs eps=0.02. Statistic s = zeta2 - zeta1. Parameter hash of the network is taken before and after.
claims.consistent_if: ALL of: (i) AUROC(s: attacked vs clean) >= 0.90 for both eps=0.01 and eps=0.02; (ii) some single threshold tau gives balanced accuracy >= 0.90 on clean-vs-attacked at each eps (the 'dataset-dependent threshold' exists on this synthetic dataset); (iii) median zeta2 > median zeta1 for attacked inputs at both eps; (iv) network parameter hash identical before/after and the whole detector executed under torch.no_grad (no retraining, no gradient needed).
claims.inconsistent_if: Any of (i)-(iv) fails; the rationale will state which criterion failed, by how much, and flag the out-of-distribution-network caveat. (Pre-stated rule: no third category.)
claims.parameters_fixed_before_run: N = 12 synthetic cases per condition (12 clean, 12 attacked at eps=0.01, the same 12 cases attacked at eps=0.02); Delta_1 for the primary statistic (Delta_2, Delta_3 reported as robustness); noise jitter std_scale=6 (Config.yaml) estimated from the tested input itself (defender view), not from the clean input
claims.execution_notes: A wiring dry run (P9_DRY=1: 2 cases, 1 attack iteration) was executed before the full run and its numbers were seen; the criteria above and the full-run parameters were not changed afterwards. Not changed after the full run.

check_C00996.py. Run the repository's Cyclic_Mitigation (Reverse PGD with defaults from Config.yaml: alpha=0.005, epsilon_proj=0.01, 3 Delta masks, cyclic_stages=2, noise_jittering_std=6, Linear alpha scheduler) on M synthetic PGD-attacked cases (M >= 3, eps=0.01; iterations fixed in script header, <= 100). Reverse_PGD_Projection and ABA_detect are wrapped by recording hooks (they still call the originals unchanged) to log, per iteration: the iterate z_t, the number of cyclic passes and the mask used in each. Also a control with the gradient sign flipped (ascent) and a short true-descent run, 10 iterations each, same start; plus the cyclic loss at the clean input (iteration 0) versus at the attacked input.
claims.consistent_if: ALL of: (a) ball: for every iteration t and case, max(|Re(z_t - z_pert)|, |Im(z_t - z_pert)|) <= epsilon_proj + 1e-6, and the iterate moves (max displacement > 0.5*epsilon_proj at some iteration); (b) multi-pattern: every iteration evaluates exactly K = 3 cyclic passes with 3 pairwise-distinct Delta masks, each different from Omega and containing at least one line of Omega^C, and the loss is the mean over them; (c) minimisation: min_t LOSS_t <= 0.95*LOSS_0 and LOSS_last < LOSS_0 in every case; (d) direction: after 10 iterations the descent run has lower cyclic loss than the start and the sign-flipped (ascent) control has higher cyclic loss than the start. Supporting, not gating: cyclic loss at the attacked input > cyclic loss at the clean input (premise of Sec. 3.1); CG-based (E_Omega^H)^dagger residual ||E^H y - z||/||z||; PSNR/SSIM trajectory against the synthetic reference.
claims.inconsistent_if: Any of (a)-(d) fails in any case; the rationale will state which criterion failed, by how much, and flag the out-of-distribution-network caveat. (Pre-stated rule: no third category.)
claims.parameters_fixed_before_run: M = 3 synthetic cases, eps=0.01; main run T = 20 iterations (paper/Config default is 100: reduced for CPU budget, Linear alpha scheduler over T); direction controls (descent and sign-flipped ascent) use T_c = 6 iterations so that LOSS[5] (loss after 5 updates) can be compared with LOSS[0]; this replaces the '10 iterations' wording in 'check' and criterion (d) 'after 10 iterations' now reads 'after 5 updates'. claims.execution_notes: A wiring dry run (P9_DRY=1: 1 case, 2 iterations) was executed before the full run and its numbers were seen; the criteria above and the full-run parameters were not changed afterwards.
